portfolio_summary: Portfolio delivery is progressing overall, with two initiatives on track, four moving forward with external dependencies, and one project currently blocked pending a security review.

projects.name: Tokenization
projects.status: 80% of VISA testing has been completed. The issues affecting the remaining 20% have now been resolved.
projects.next_step: Complete the remaining testing with VISA and TAPPY.
notes: The core testing stream is substantially complete.
Remaining work is dependent on final validation from VISA and TAPPY.

projects.name: TSP
projects.status: The initiative is currently in the discovery stage, and the implementation project plan is awaited from the vendor.
projects.next_step: Start joint discovery sessions between the TSP vendor and the digital card profile vendor next week.
notes: The digital card profile vendor has already been engaged.
Execution planning depends on alignment between both vendors.

projects.name: Digital First → Reveal Card
projects.status: The solution has been finalized and is awaiting development kickoff from Super QI and MuleSoft.
projects.next_step: Confirm the development start date and delivery milestones with Super QI and MuleSoft.
notes: No solution design issue is outstanding.
The immediate dependency is development mobilization.

projects.name: PCI PIN
projects.status: Development of the core system has been completed, and the team is preparing for certification.
projects.next_step: Begin certification readiness activities and align the submission plan.
notes: Delivery has moved from build into certification preparation.
The project is currently on track.

projects.name: PURE
projects.status: PURE cards have been personalized and shipped to the team for testing.
projects.next_step: Execute the planned testing cycle and capture any findings.
notes: The physical card preparation step has been completed.
Testing readiness is now the key focus.

projects.name: Self-Service Kiosk
projects.status: Proof-of-concept activities with multiple vendors are planned.
projects.next_step: Schedule vendor demonstrations and evaluate the proposed solutions.
notes: The initiative is still at an early evaluation stage.
Vendor comparison will determine the preferred path forward.

projects.name: QI Tap
projects.status: QI Tap was removed from production by the security team, although it does not interface with ISC systems and is a third-party application integrated with the Scheme TSP.
projects.next_step: Complete the security review starting on Sunday, 12 April, and confirm the remediation or reinstatement path.
notes: This is the main portfolio risk requiring management attention.
The dependency is the outcome of the security review.
